messages:
Maya (Finance): Quick heads-up — new delegated vendor approval flow + virtual-card policy goes live Monday Apr 10. This changes who can sign off on suppliers and raises the auto-approve virtual card threshold. Please skim the summary and the Confluence page: https://confluence.redwood/finance/vendor-delegation :eyes:

Alex (Procurement): TL;DR of thresholds (effective Apr 10):
```
- <$2k: Team lead approval (submit via #procurement-ticket)
- $2k–$25k: Dept finance approval + procurement review
- >$25k: Procurement + Legal signoff + exec notification
- Recurring SaaS renewals: auto virtual-card approval if <$1,000/month
```

Josh (Eng): For clarity — does the recurring SaaS auto-vcard apply to multiyear discounts or only monthly invoices? Example: Datadog invoice billed annually for $8k — is that auto?

Maya (Finance): Good q. Recurring auto-approve applies to the cadence billed on the card. Annual $8k would not be eligible for auto-vcard if the single charge > $1,000. If you want an exception for a one-time annual discount, tag @Alex (Procurement) + @Maya (Finance) in the ticket.

Priya (Legal): Also note: any contract > $25k or where the vendor will process customer PII requires a Data Processing Addendum (DPA) and Legal approval. Put "DPA required" in the procurement ticket.

Samir (Ops): Bandwidth question — new vendor onboarding SLA? We've had some delays for APAC vendors.

Alex (Procurement): Onboarding SLA update: 3–5 business days for basic vendors (no special compliance), 7–12 business days for vendors requiring KYC/DPA/HIPAA review. APAC bank verifications may add 2–3 days. If it's urgent, mark ticket as "expedite" and include justification.

Maya (Finance): Reminder on documentation: always attach vendor W-9/W-8 (as applicable), vendor questionnaire, and bank details. Missing docs are the #1 cause of delay.

Josh (Eng): Got it — any changes to virtual-card provisioning? Our team frequently requests short-lived cards for contractors.

Alex (Procurement): Process for short-lived v-cards unchanged — still request via the procurement form and label the card with project & expiration. Approval path follows the thresholds above.

Priya (Legal): One more: subscriptions that involve customer data access must include security questionnaire results. Procurement will flag tickets missing that.

Maya (Finance): Action items: teams with standing vendor spend > $10k/month should schedule a quick sync with Procurement this quarter so we can map delegation. If you need training on the new flow, sign up on the Confluence page. :calendar:

procurement-bot: Virtual card policy updated in system: auto-approve threshold set to $1,000/month for recurring charges. (ID: VC-2026-04) :white_check_mark:

Samir (Ops): Thanks — will forward to APAC leads. :thumbsup:

Alex (Procurement): If anyone hits a blocker, ping me or open a ticket with subject prefix: "PROCURE-ESCALATE".

Maya (Finance): Thanks all. We'll post recorded walkthrough and FAQ later today. If you want a walkthrough session for your org, reply here with preferred days/time. :slightly_smiling_face:
